flow_ref: User story (not in the flow deck OCMS)
code_summary: Only scaffolding in ocmsadminui: utils/Meta/System.ts (path/title), utils/mapping/SystemAdmin.ts (COMPLAINANT_CODE mapping), utils/validation/Format/ValidFile.ts (file rules), utils/models/{Fsystemadmin,Fapi,Icourtcase,Icsdbatch}.d.ts (types). No route, page, menu, controller, entity or cron. ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: no complainant code.
note: The story asks that the officer selects a complainant code and downloads/uploads the signature that is interfaced to State Courts. The code does not have this feature: no route/page/menu, no download or upload endpoint, no signature storage and no interface to State Courts. Only unwired scaffolding exists in ocmsadminui: the oic_signature mapping (SystemAdmin.ts:90-95) and the signature/complainant_code file rules (ValidFile.ts:177-190), which nobody calls. No maintenance ticket mentions complainant or signature. The 'Fully paid' status is not supported by code in the repos (cannot verify from repo whether it was built outside these six repos).
recommendation: Do not claim as done based on code. Ask URA/the team where the complainant signature code lives, or mark it as a gap.

steps.step: Officer selects a complainant code on the maintenance screen
steps.detail: The System Admin menu only has Parameter, Standard Code, Suspension Reason, Offence Rule Code, Schedule Public Holiday (ocmsadminui/src/utils/data/LinkData.tsx:70-109); the /system routes in App.tsx only cover parameter, standardcode, computer-rule-code, suspension-reason, schedule-public-holiday (ocmsadminui/src/App.tsx:375-500). There is no route, menu, list or form for complainant. Only behaviourless scaffolding exists: a path constant '/system/complainant-code' (System.ts:10, 44) and the title 'Complainant Code' (System.ts:115-118), which no route, menu or page uses.

steps.step: Officer downloads the stored complainant signature
steps.detail: SystemAdmin.ts:90-95 has a COMPLAINANT_CODE.DOC_SOURCE mapping (oic_signature, oic_signature_data, category COMPLAINANT_SIGNATURE) and a GET that attaches files to the data, but MapSystemAdmin.COMPLAINANT_CODE is not called from any component (grep in ocmsadminui/src, 0 users outside that file). There is no signature download endpoint. No entity, repository, controller or SQL named complainant / signature / oic_signature exists in ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmseserviceapi, thirdpartyapi (case-insensitive grep over src, 0 relevant hits; the stale ocmsadminprivateapi/cronservice copy was ignored).

steps.step: Officer uploads a new signature for the selected complainant code
steps.detail: ValidFile.ts:177-180 (signature: max 7, Image format) and 187-190 (complainant_code: max 20, pdf/png/jpg/jpeg) are file validation rules only; nothing calls ValidFile['signature'] or ['complainant_code'] (only email, photo, video, upload_notices are used). There is no upload component and no receiving endpoint. No entity, repository, controller or SQL named complainant / signature / oic_signature exists in ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmseserviceapi, thirdpartyapi (case-insensitive grep over src, 0 relevant hits; the stale ocmsadminprivateapi/cronservice copy was ignored).

steps.step: The signature is stored and linked to the complainant code
steps.detail: The oic_signature / oic_signature_data mapping (SystemAdmin.ts:92-93) hints at planned columns, but no entity, repository or blob storage handler for the complainant signature exists in any backend. No entity, repository, controller or SQL named complainant / signature / oic_signature exists in ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmseserviceapi, thirdpartyapi (case-insensitive grep over src, 0 relevant hits; the stale ocmsadminprivateapi/cronservice copy was ignored). Column/table names in the DB: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The signature is interfaced to State Courts
steps.detail: No job, SFTP upload or API sends the signature to State Courts. Icsdbatch.d.ts is only a type with complainant_code and chargesheet/complaintletter blobs (lines 8-14), with nothing filling it in the backends. The State Courts side and SFTP partner: cannot verify from repo.
